task_instance: Run the skill's Quick Start Option A smoke test: `inspect-ai` eval of a Hugging Face Hub model (meta-llama/Llama-3.2-1B) on the mmlu task via HF Inference Providers with --limit 20, as documented in SKILL.md.
blocker_detail: The skill's core deliverable requires reaching Hugging Face services: Option A (inference-providers path) needs HTTPS access to huggingface.co and router.huggingface.co; both are blocked by the sandbox's egress proxy with 'CONNECT tunnel failed, response 403 / connect_rejected (organization policy)'. Options B and C (local GPU eval with vllm/Transformers/accelerate) additionally require a GPU (nvidia-smi is not installed/available in this runtime) and also need to download the model weights from huggingface.co, which is likewise blocked. No HF_TOKEN is set either, but the network block occurs before credentials would even matter. Additionally, the skill's own scripts directory (scripts/inspect_eval_uv.py, scripts/inspect_vllm_uv.py, scripts/lighteval_vllm_uv.py, examples/USAGE_EXAMPLES.md) referenced throughout SKILL.md is not present in the skill source (only SKILL.md and LICENSE exist), so even the invocation commands themselves could not be run as documented.
evidence: Confirmed via SKILL.md that scripts/ referenced by the skill do not exist (find over the skill source dir shows only SKILL.md and LICENSE). Confirmed no GPU: `nvidia-smi` -> 'command not found'. Confirmed no HF_TOKEN set: `printenv HF_TOKEN` -> NOTSET. Installed inspect-ai successfully via `uv pip install inspect-ai` (pypi.org is allowed through the proxy), proving the local tooling itself is installable. Then attempted to reach the two Hugging Face endpoints the skill's Option A depends on: `curl https://huggingface.co/api/models/meta-llama/Llama-3.2-1B` and `curl https://router.huggingface.co/v1/models`, both returned curl exit code 56 with proxy message 'CONNECT tunnel failed, response 403' / 'connect_rejected (the egress proxy denied the CONNECT (organization policy))'. Checked proxy status endpoint (`curl $HTTPS_PROXY/__agentproxy/status`) which lists an explicit noProxy allowlist that does not include any huggingface.co domain, confirming this is a deliberate organization policy block rather than a transient failure. This makes it impossible to run any actual evaluation against a Hugging Face Hub model in this runtime, whether via Inference Providers (Option A) or via local GPU model download (Options B/C, which also lack a GPU).
